title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Late Fee Amount
content:
**Cardholder agreement — amount of the late fee.** The late fee on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account is the tier's first late fee, as the fee schedule lists it, limited — on a tier whose late fee is capped at the minimum payment due — to the latest statement's minimum payment due. The figures used are those of the latest statement issued, and the fee is kept to the cent.

| Condition | Judgement | Late fee |
|---|---|---|
| Tier's late fee capped at the minimum payment due, and the tier's first late fee is at or below the latest statement's minimum payment due | the first late fee stands | the tier's first late fee |
| Tier's late fee capped, and the latest statement's minimum payment due is below the tier's first late fee | the limit applies | the latest statement's minimum payment due |
| Tier's late fee not capped | no limit | the tier's first late fee |

## Worked figures (hypothetical statements, using the fee schedule's figures)

| Account | First late fee | Capped | Latest statement's minimum payment due | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Card Preferred | 32.00 | yes | 60.00 | 32.00 |
| Card Classic | 32.00 | yes | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Project Loan 78 | 39.00 | no | 25.00 | 39.00 |

**Latest statement.** The latest statement is the most recent statement issued on the account; its minimum payment due is the figure the limit uses.
